newsitem.title: BELGIUM: Belgian BBL launches Czech invest fund.
newsitem.headline: Belgian BBL launches Czech invest fund.

text.p: Belgian bank Banque Bruxelles Lambert SA (BBL) and its 51-percent owned unit MC BBL Eastern Holdings have launched a Czech investment fund, BBL said in a statement on Tuesday.

The fund, which is being managed by Patria Asset Management a.s., will invest mainly in equities, but could also invest in public and private debt issues, BBL said. Patria is 49 percent held by MC BBL Eastern Holdings.
BBL said shares in the fund would be sold until January 17 at 500 marks or 2,500 marks, depending on whether they capitalised or paid out the dividends received, plus commission.
